note: Language-neutral mailbox script for the MCP `poll_inbox` contract. The Go oracle (rust-tests/parity/oracle/mcp-poll-inbox) and the Rust replay test both read this file and script the same mailbox; neither hand-writes a transcript. The scripted SearchUID deliberately ignores the `since` argument: the policy computes that window from the wall clock, so filtering on it would make the answer move. `uid_validity` is fixed, so a fresh high-water-mark store always cold-starts.
